# Blur

**Category:** Render  
**Aliases:** Blur

## What it does

Blurs background when in GUI screens.

Description basis: [publisher description](https://github.com/MeteorDevelopment/meteor-client/blob/e3a2e77967629d216e127b5ceecf71fb15f9d2e5/src/main/java/meteordevelopment/meteorclient/systems/modules/render/Blur.java).
